Register an R vector class as an extension type

Source: R/types.R
register_extension_type.Rd

A package whose vector class has an Arrow extension name, such as a geometry class, registers it so that zutable types its columns as that extension rather than as an opaque r_class(). Call it from the package's .onLoad().

Usage

register_extension_type(name, ptype, storage)

Arguments

name

The extension name, for example "geoarrow.wkb".

ptype

A zero-length vector of the class. Its first class names the class, and ptype[NA_integer_] is the type's missing value.

storage

The storage type, as in schema(), for example binary.

Value

The extension type, invisibly.

Examples

register_extension_type("example.celsius", structure(double(), class = "celsius"), float64)
schema(t = extension("example.celsius"))
#> <zutable_schema> 1 field
#>   t extension("example.celsius")
